lists.content:

  • Master Value-Based Selling: Partner closely with internal Solution Consultants and Customer Success Managers to build and present ROI-driven business cases for enterprise prospects.

  • Inbound & Outbound Strategy: Actively hunt for new enterprise opportunities through outbound prospecting while strategically managing high-value inbound lead requests.

• Enterprise SaaS Expertise: 6+ years of proven success in Enterprise Software Sales (SaaS) or Strategic Business Consulting, consistently hitting or exceeding seven-figure quotas.

  • Nordic Market Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the business landscape, cultural nuances, and executive networks within the Nordic region.
  • Technical Curiosity: Experience selling sophisticated, high-tech platform solutions with the ability to comfortably bridge the gap between business value and technical execution.
  • Collaborative Spirit: A proven ability to quarterback complex deals by leveraging internal teams (SEs, CSMs, Partner/SAP ecosystems).

People Management

  • Lead training, and nurturing talent across the technical delivery team by providing coaching, skills development, and career planning.

  • Manage team performance, acting on internal and customer feedback about team quality of work.

  • Develop and embed best practices for implementation methodology and cross-team collaboration.

  • Promote understanding of new product features to ensure the team maintains advanced knowledge.

  • Foster an open, productive, and trust-based team dynamic through an inquisitive and supportive leadership approach.

    • WalkMe Implementation & Delivery

    • Oversee the delivery of the team's implementation projects, ensuring ongoing focus on value and quality.

    • Design, guide, and review the build of interactive WalkMe experiences that enhance end-user onboarding, accelerate feature adoption, and drive business impact.

    • Manage team capacity and partner with SE Leads to resource customer engagements, coordinating efforts where needed.

    • Serve as the primary contact for customer escalations, in partnership with the Account Management team.

      • Consultation & Customer Success

      • Partner with customers' application owners to understand their business objectives, pain points, and end-user needs, providing expert WalkMe recommendations.

      • Conduct and oversee training sessions for customers on WalkMe best practices to maximize product value.

      • Ensure smooth troubleshooting and resolution of WalkMe implementation issues across platforms and devices.

      • Foster strong cross-functional collaboration with UX/UI designers, developers, customer success teams, and other stakeholders.

        • Strategy & Continuous Improvement

        • Use data inputs to provide recommendations that support ongoing team and process improvement.

        • Partner with peers and Services leadership to implement the long-term team vision.

        • Stay updated with the latest trends and advancements in WalkMe and digital adoption technologies, promoting continuous learning within the team.

          •  

          ピープルマネジメント

          • 日本におけるテクニカルデリバリーチーム全体を率い、コーチング、スキル開発、キャリアプランニングを通じて人材を育成する。

          • チームの成果物に対する社内・顧客からのフィードバックに基づき、チームのパフォーマンスを管理する。

          • 導入手法やチーム間コラボレーションに関するベストプラクティスを策定し、定着させる。

          • 新機能の理解を促進し、チームが常に高度な知識を学び身に着けられるようにする。

          • オープンで生産的、かつ信頼に基づいたチームダイナミクスを醸成する。

            • WalkMeの導入とデリバリー（Implementation & Delivery）

            • チームの導入プロジェクトを統括し、継続的に価値と品質を追求する。

            • ユーザーのオンボーディングを強化し、機能活用を促進し、ビジネスインパクトを創出するためのインタラクティブなWalkMe体験の設計、ガイダンス、および構築レビューを行う。

              • コンサルテーション & カスタマーサクセス

              • 顧客のアプリケーションオーナーとパートナーシップを築き、ビジネス目標、課題、エンドユーザーのニーズを深く理解した上で、WalkMe活用のための専門的な推奨事項を提供する。

              • 製品価値を最大化するため、WalkMeのベストプラクティスに関する顧客向けトレーニングを実施・監督する。

              • 様々なプラットフォームやデバイスにおけるWalkMe導入時のトラブルシューティングと問題解決を円滑に進める。

              • UX/UIデザイナー、開発者、カスタマーサクセスチーム、その他のステークホルダーと緊密に連携し、部門横断的なコラボレーションを推進する。

                • 戦略 & 継続的改善

                • データに基づき、継続的なチームおよびプロセスの改善に向けた推奨事項を提供する。

                • チームの長期的なビジョンを実現するため、他のマネージャー層やサービス部門のリーダーシップと連携する。

                • WalkMeやデジタルアダプション技術の最新トレンドを常に把握し、チーム内での継続的な学習を促進する。

lists.text: What You Need to Succeed/応募要件
lists.content:
• 7+ years of experience in Professional Services, Implementation Consulting, or Customer Success, delivering enterprise-level SaaS implementations.

  • 3+ years of SaaS experience.

  • 2+ years managing a team of small members, including recruiting and developing talent.

  • Experience managing team goals and performance.

  • Experience partnering with leadership peers to improve cross-team collaboration and developing new team skills to accommodate growth.

  • Previous experience with the WalkMe platform or other similar user guidance and onboarding tools is a plus.

  • Strong understanding of user behavior and how to improve user engagement through digital adoption platforms.

  • Analytical mindset, capable of interpreting data to make data-driven decisions and optimize WalkMe implementations.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and with senior stakeholders.

  • Strong project management skills, with demonstrated ability to oversee multiple engagements within timeline and resources.

  • A passion for providing an outstanding service experience to every customer.

  • Experience working in an agile development environment is a plus.

  • Come to the office 3 times a week.

  • Native level of Japanese and Business English.

    •  

    応募要件（What You Need to Succeed）

    • プロフェッショナルサービス、導入コンサルティング、またはカスタマーサクセスにおける7年以上の経験（エンタープライズレベルのSaaS導入経験必須）。

    • 3年以上のSaaS経験。

    • 小規模チームのマネジメント経験（採用および人材育成を含む）。

    • チームの目標管理およびパフォーマンス管理の経験。

    • リーダー層と連携し、部門横断的なコラボレーションの改善や、成長に合わせたチームの新たなスキルセット開発を主導した経験。

    • WalkMeプラットフォーム、または類似のユーザーガイダンス／オンボーディングツールの使用経験があれば尚可。

    • ユーザー行動への深い理解と、デジタルアダプションプラットフォームを通じたエンゲージメント向上の知見。

    • データを解釈し、データに基づいた意思決定とWalkMe導入の最適化を行える分析的な思考力。

    • 優れたコミュニケーション能力とコラボレーション能力（チーム間やシニアステークホルダーと効果的に働けること）。

    • 強力なプロジェクト管理スキル（限られたリソースと期間内で複数の案件を統括できること）。

    • すべての顧客に卓越したサービス体験を提供することへの情熱。

    • アジャイル開発環境での実務経験があれば尚可。

    • 週3日のオフィス出社。

    • 日本語ネイティブレベル、ビジネス英語レベル。

  • リソースの必要性を確立するための内部的な関係構築力
  • テンポの速い環境で一貫して高いレベルの顧客満足度と維持率を提供しながら、戦略的に考え、実行することができること

  •  最高レベルの誠実さを持ったチームプレーヤー

  • 週３回オフィス出社
  • 3+ years of relevant Customer Success / Account Management / Project Management and Consultant experience, with  Fortune 500 organizations. 
  • Demonstrates high competency in sales discovery methodologies and strategic value  and ROI discussions.  
  • Strong commercial and technical aptitude can confidently discuss technical aspects  alongside commercial negotiations.   Relationship management internally to establish resource needs.  
  • Ability to design pricing strategy and articulate commercial aspects of the agreement. 
  • Demonstrable success in thinking strategically, executing tactically while providing  consistent and high levels of customer satisfaction and retention in a fast-paced  environment.
  • Knowledge and experience of web application, CSS and HTML.
  • Natural proactive nature who works to curb reactive behaviors and go above and  beyond the call of duty but approaches all situations with and empathetic and patient  manner. 
  •  Experience in an enterprise solution sales environment and ability to partner with  account executives in development and closure of sales opportunities is preferred. 
  •  Highly data-driven with a commitment to process. Excited about driving and tracking  a consistent engagement process with all customers in your portfolio.  
  • Team player with the highest level of integrity. This is a WalkMe core value.                
  • Native level in Japanese and business level English                
  • Must be in the office 3 times a week.

WalkMe, an SAP company, pioneered the world's leading Digital Adoption Platform, helping organizations navigate change across any application or system. Today it is the platform that drives AI adoption across the enterprise. Enterprise work stays fragmented across applications, and that fragmentation compounds as AI advances. Traditional training and vendor-provided help leave organizations managing change one application at a time. WalkMe guides people through change, brings AI into the flow of work, automates tasks and shows executives how workflows perform. Global leaders including IBM, Nestlé, Thermo Fisher Scientific, and the U.S. federal government trust WalkMe. WalkMe turns AI potential into AI performance.
 
So, if you’re an expert in your field, and looking for an opportunity to work, collaborate, and innovate with some of the most talented people out there, WalkMe is the place for you!


As a Senior Partner Solution Advisor, you will report to the Director of Global Partner Solution Advisory. You'll bring deep technical credibility — built through hands-on presales, solution consulting, or sales engineering experience — to WalkMe's partner ecosystem, designing and delivering demonstrations and POCs that prove out real business value. Working alongside Partner Business Managers, you'll translate that technical depth into partner capability: defining joint value propositions and go-to-market strategies, and enabling partner sales and technical teams to confidently identify, position, and close WalkMe opportunities

lists.text: What will you actually be doing?
lists.content:
• Release & Launch Execution: Run an evolving monthly release motion end to end — scoping the narrative and bill of materials, coordinating cross-functional contributors, producing the assets, and landing the launch internally and externally.

  • Product-Led Growth: Support our self-service trial experience as a pipeline engine. Shape the packaging, in-product messaging, and conversion paths that turn self-serve users into qualified enterprise opportunities, and run rapid experiments to improve them.

  • Positioning & Messaging: Develop clear, compelling positioning and value propositions for our flagship platform products, grounded in real customer pain points and business objectives. Translate product functionality and technical detail into user benefits — both for individual capabilities and for their role in the broader platform narrative.

  • Go-to-Market Strategy: Build differentiated GTM strategies covering pricing and packaging, customer evidence, product requirements, and content, tailored to the segments and functional audiences we sell into.

  • Asset Ownership: Own the development and maintenance of the product marketing assets for the products in your scope, from web and demo content to decks and one-pagers, keeping it accurate as the products evolve.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Operate as the connective tissue across Product & Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and the wider Marketing org — driving alignment and momentum in a matrixed environment without waiting to be handed a plan.

  • Sales Enablement: Help train and equip the field so sellers can position and sell the platform confidently to the product-qualified leads created by the trial experiences.

  • Market Research: Track a fast-moving category — competitors, analysts, customers, and our own sellers — and feed what you learn back into roadmap input and GTM execution.

  • Product Analysis: Monitor product-line health and commercial success metrics to find the gaps worth closing and the growth worth chasing.

lists.text: What should you bring to the table?
lists.content:
• 5+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience, with at least 3 years in a product marketing seat.

  • A proven track record of bringing new products to market and executing releases and launches on a repeating cadence.

  • Hands-on product-led growth or product-led sales experience, including pricing and packaging decisions and self-service conversion.

  • Demonstrated, day-to-day use of AI tools in your own PMM work — we'll want concrete examples of how they change how you operate, not a passing familiarity.

  • Strong project management instincts: the ability to navigate matrixed cross-functional teams, hold multiple products and programs at once, and catalyze rapid experimentation.

  • Broad market research and analytical skills to inform and validate positioning, scoping, and product strategy.

  • Native-level fluency in English required, native-level fluency in Hebrew is an advantage.
  • Ability to independently collaborate across teams and juggle shifting priorities.

• Experience marketing within a multi-product platform.

  • MBA or consulting, investment banking, or venture capital background.

  • Prior growth marketing, solutions/sales engineering, or product management experience.

lists.text: What You'll Own/主な職務内容
lists.content:
• WalkMe Implementation: Design, build, and implement interactive experiences for our customers to enhance their end-user onboarding experience, accelerate feature adoption, and drive business impact.

  • Consultation: Work closely with customer application owners to understand their business objectives, pain points, and end-user needs. Provide expert advice and recommend WalkMe solutions that align with their goals and improve user experiences.

  • Project Management: Lead end-to-end WalkMe projects, collaborating with customers, internal stakeholders, and the development team to ensure successful delivery within scope, timeline, and budget. Effectively manage project risks and provide regular status updates to all involved parties.

  • Training and Enablement: Conduct training sessions for customers on WalkMe best practices, ensuring they can make the most of the product and effectively utilize its features to enhance their applications.

  • Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve any issues related to WalkMe implementation, ensuring smooth functionality across different platforms and devices.

  • Collaboration: Foster strong cross-functional collaboration with UX/UI designers, developers, customer success teams, and other stakeholders.

  • Continuous Learning: Stay updated with the latest trends and advancements in WalkMe and digital adoption technologies. 

  • Consultative Sales Mindset: Ability to identify expansion opportunities where WalkMe could solve problems in other departments or applications within the customer's organization.Solution Architecture & Mapping: Translate complex business processes into logical WalkMe solutions with high technical integrity; ensuring every build is architecturally sound, aligned with business KPIs, and designed for a frictionless end user journey that accelerates digital adoption.

  • WalkMe導入： お客様のエンドユーザーのオンボーディング体験を強化し、機能の採用を促進し、ビジネスへの影響を駆動するために、対話型のエクスペリエンスを設計、構築、導入します。

  • コンサルテーション： お客様のアプリケーションオーナーと密接に連携し、ビジネス目標、課題、エンドユーザーのニーズを理解します。専門的なアドバイスを提供し、彼らの目標に合致しユーザーエクスペリエンスを向上させるWalkMeソリューションを推奨します。

  • プロジェクト管理： WalkMeプロジェクトをエンドツーエンドで主導し、お客様、社内関係者、開発チームと協力して、スコープ、タイムライン、予算内で確実に成功裏に納品します。プロジェクトリスクを効果的に管理し、関係者全員に定期的な進捗状況の更新を提供します。

  • トレーニングとイネーブルメント： お客様に対しWalkMeのベストプラクティスに関するトレーニングセッションを実施し、製品を最大限に活用し、その機能を効果的に使用してアプリケーションを強化できるようにします。

lists.text: What You Need to Succeed / 成功のために必要な要件
lists.content:

  • Strong understanding of user behavior and how to improve user engagement through WalkMe.

  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS to customize and integrate WalkMe elements into web applications.

  • Analytical mindset, capable of interpreting data to make data-driven decisions and optimize WalkMe implementations.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

  • Attention to detail, ensuring WalkMe elements are visually appealing, user-friendly, and aligned with our brand guidelines.

  • Problem-solving skills, capable of troubleshooting and resolving issues related to WalkMe implementations.

  • Experience in project management, demonstrating the ability to coordinate tasks effectively within timeline and resources.

  • Experience working in an agile development environment is a plus.

  • 3+ years of experience in Professional Services, Implementation Consulting, or Customer Success.

  • 3+ years of SaaS experience.

  • Native level Japanese and Beginner Business  proficiency (reading and writing)

  • Come to the Tokyo office 3 times in a week

  • WalkMeプラットフォームまたは他の類似のユーザーガイダンスおよびオンボーディングツールに関する実務経験があれば尚可。

  • ユーザーの行動と、WalkMeを通じてユーザーエンゲージメントを向上させる方法について深い理解があること。

  • WalkMe要素をウェブアプリケーションにカスタマイズおよび統合するためのHTML、CSSの知識。

  • Technical advisory: Act as the main technical advisor for your accounts. Talk through different architecture setups and their trade-offs, and give best-practice guidance on deployment, performance and reliability.

  • Troubleshooting and escalations: Troubleshoot deployment issues, including browser/OS compatibility and performance. Join high-severity cases as a product expert and customer advocate.

  • Cross-functional liaison: Be the link between customers, Product, Engineering, Support and the Customer Success team. Close gaps, run the conversations and keep everyone aligned on features, technical hurdles and the roadmap.

  • Customer education: Help customers understand how the platform works technically, including infrastructure, privacy and security.

  • Documentation: Write and maintain technical documentation such as installation guides, configuration guides and troubleshooting materials.

  • Relationships: Build trust with customers, know them well, and speak up for them inside WalkMe.

lists.content:
• Customer onboarding and technical readiness: Lead new customer onboarding and make sure environments are ready for deployment, including network configuration.

  • Technical advisory: Act as the main technical advisor for your accounts. Talk through different architecture setups and their trade-offs, and give best-practice guidance on deployment, performance and reliability.

  • Troubleshooting and escalations: Troubleshoot deployment issues, including browser/OS compatibility and performance. Join high-severity cases as a product expert and customer advocate.

  • Ownership and risk management: Take full ownership of your work, push things forward, clear roadblocks, and flag risks or blockers early.

  • Strategic direction: Plan and advise on solutions and enhancements that support the customer’s business needs and long-term technical continuity.

  • Cross-functional liaison: Be the link between customers, Product, Engineering, Support and the Customer Success team. Close gaps, run the conversations and keep everyone aligned on features, technical hurdles and the roadmap.

  • Customer education: Help customers understand how the platform works technically, including infrastructure, privacy and security.

  • Documentation: Write and maintain technical documentation such as installation guides, configuration guides and troubleshooting materials.

  • Relationships: Build trust with customers, know them well, and speak up for them inside WalkMe.

Technical Skills

  • Experience with web technologies (JavaScript, HTML, CSS) and building with APIs

  • Knowledge of Chromium-based extension APIs and permissions

  • Hands-on software deployment experience across Windows, macOS and VDI, including mass deployment tools and policies

  • Experience with Identity and Access Management, including setting up identity provider integrations and working with SAML, OAuth, OIDC, SSO and MFA

  • Working understanding of SaaS architecture, cloud delivery models and IT infrastructure (servers, databases, networking, compute)

  • Familiarity with tools like JIRA and internal knowledge bases

    • Professional Skills

  • Strong communicator who sets expectations, shares updates proactively, listens with empathy, and adjusts the message for C-level, technical and business audiences

  • Strong project management skills and a track record of running several deployments at once and delivering on time

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and able to solve open-ended problems when there’s no set process

  • Able to turn customer needs into technical requirements

  • Customer-service mindset; IT helpdesk or customer-facing technical experience is a plus

  • Driven and fast-moving: you follow through quickly and don’t let blockers slow you down

  • Collaborative: we’re one team, and we support each other

    • Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related STEM field, or equivalent experience

  • Experience in the digital adoption space is preferred

lists.content:
• Implementation & Build: Build, configure, and implement digital adoption solutions embedded within complex web applications according to defined requirements, timelines, and quality standards.
  • System & Process Analysis: Analyze and research customer use cases, user workflows, and application processes in web systems to design scalable technical solutions.
  • Technical Troubleshooting & Monitoring: Monitor production logs in backoffice systems to proactively identify and address potential issues before they impact end-users. Serve as an internal point of escalation for Support and Technical teams to drive root-cause resolutions.
  • Solution Architecture & Execution: Participate in solution design discussions, owning assigned build components end-to-end—including DOM manipulation, custom scripting, configuration, testing, and iterating based on feedback.
